correctness.rationale: The exact candidate set is proved both admissible and greedy-complete. The three modular sumsets E-hat-plus-E, E+R and R+R are disjoint from the selected residue set R; R+R includes equal residues so that distinct tail integers in the same residue class are covered. Explicit witness tables cover every rejected position in one full period and translate to every later period. The ordered residue blocks yield the stated difference word, and unique gap values certify minimal period. Exact finite checks agree with the theorem throughout the documented range.

originality.rationale: Van Berkel and Bosma's September 2026 paper identifies g<=2f-1 as the prior infinite proven region and presents g=2f as a new diagonal theorem; cases beyond the diagonal are supported there by conjectures and finite computations. Searches for S_{f,2f+1}, S_{f,2f+2}, and equivalent greedy strict 2-sumfree and 0-additive formulations did not locate an earlier infinite theorem. Residual risk remains because Queneau's 1972 foundational article was not inspected in full and because the motivating preprints are recent.

value.rationale: The result advances the exact infinite frontier by two complete parameter lines and supplies closed residue descriptions, minimal periods and preperiods, explicit periodic difference words, and densities. It turns two computationally supported portions of the general periodicity conjecture into direct theorems for all f>=5.
